login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Log in to access your interview history and dashboard.
login.googleFailed: Sign-in with Google couldn't be completed. Try again or use email/password.
login.accountNotLinked: An account already exists for this email with a password, but the email hasn't been verified yet. Verify it first, then sign in with Google — or you can still sign in with your password.

loginForm.consentNote: Your account details are used to secure your sign-in. Some data is retained for security and support purposes. By continuing, you agree to the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.
loginForm.unverifiedError: Your account hasn't been verified yet. If the verification link expired, you can request a new one below.

register.title: Create an account
register.subtitle: Start your free, AI-powered interview rehearsal in a few minutes.

registerForm.consentNote: After signing up, you will be asked to read and accept the Personal Data Protection Notice and the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy on your first login.
registerForm.successMessage: Registration received. Click the verification link sent to your email.

resendVerification.genericMessage: If this email is registered, a new verification link has been sent. Check your inbox and spam folder.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot my password
forgotPassword.sentMessage: If your email address is registered, a reset link has been sent. Check your inbox.
forgotPassword.description: Enter your account's email address and we'll send you a reset link.
forgotPassword.genericError: The request could not be sent. Please try again.

resetPassword.title: Set a new password
resetPassword.subtitle: Set a new password for your account.
resetPassword.invalidLink: The link is invalid or has expired. Please request a new reset link.
resetPassword.successSubtitle: Your password has been changed. You can now log in with your new password.

verifyEmail.title: Email verification
verifyEmail.success: Email verified. You can now log in.
verifyEmail.error: Verification failed. The link may be invalid or expired.

adminLogin.title: Admin login
adminLogin.subtitle: Login is only possible with email and password.
